verdict.rationale: Sierra documents grounding the agent in managed knowledge (Help Center content, FAQs, policies), configurable guardrails via Ghostwriter, and traceability of the knowledge sources behind each answer. These support keeping answers tied to approved knowledge, but nothing describes anti-hallucination enforcement or a safe-decline behavior for off-knowledge questions. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that the agent declines or escalates when knowledge is missing, specific guardrails against inventing prices, policies or promises, and independent or hands-on corroboration of hallucination prevention.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, guardrails stop the agent from inventing policies, prices, or promises — off-knowledge questions get a safe decline, not a guess

citations.quote: View, manage, and edit knowledge data such as Help Center content, FAQs, and policies that ground your agent.
Update workflows, systems integrations, guardrails, tone, and style with simple prompts.
Understand the reasoning behind every agent action or answer—view knowledge sources, systems accessed, and more.
